english.note: Use this colloquial choice for something astonishing, extreme, or amazingly impressive rather than literally unbelievable.
This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for something astonishingly excessive, surprising, or shocking.
Use this colloquial choice when the surprising quality is an extreme or unbelievable degree.
Use this when ridiculous means astonishingly extreme, such as an unbelievably high level of strength or performance.
Use this when something is astonishingly extreme or spectacular, especially effects, results, or a situation.
